headline: Public comment and a staff presentation on the ZA-27-01 inclusionary zoning amendment, with a possible decision on next steps.
summary: Staff will present the full ZA-27-01 proposal, followed by group discussion and public comment on it. A separate public forum covers topics unrelated to the amendment.
items: Public forum on ZA-27-01 inclusionary zoning
Staff presentation and discussion of the ZA-27-01 amendment
Public forum on ZA-27-01 inclusionary zoning (second)
Discussion and possible action on the ZA-27-01 amendment
Public forum on topics unrelated to ZA-27-01 inclusionary zoning
location: Bushor Conference Room (Room 102), 1st Floor of City Hall, 149 Church St., and via Zoom
